title: Re-importing the old number of a case-only rename updates that part
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test with its part number in capital letters, Min 1, Max 5 and 3 in bin location A, then rename it to the same number in small letters, so its old number differs from the new one only in letter case.
  • Have a parts import file with one row whose part number is part A's old number in capital letters, with Min 3, Max 9, quantity 3 and bin location A.
  • Start on the Inventory data import page (Settings, then Data Import, then Inventory).
custom_steps:
1. Upload the file.
  2. Run the import.
  3. Click Parts in the top bar.
  4. Click Inventory in the left menu.
  5. Type part A's new number in the Search box.
  6. Click the Inactive tab.
  7. Click Part Library in the left menu.
  8. Type part A's new number in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The file is ready to import.

Step 2:

  • The import finishes and does not refuse the row.

Step 3:

  • The Parts left menu shows Inventory.

Step 4:

  • The Inventory page opens.

Step 5:

  • Still exactly one row, reading part A's small-letter number, now with Min 3 and Max 9 and 3 in bin location A: no second part was added.

Step 6:

  • The Inactive tab lists no row for it: the one part A stays on the Active tab.

Step 7:

  • The Part Library page opens.

Step 8:

  • One entry is listed, with part A's small-letter number.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog), story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description)

  • S13-N9a: “When an import row's number matches a Part Library entry that is already stocked as a part at this location, the import updates that part. It never adds a second part on the same entry. A match ignores upper and lower case, hyphens, asterisks, periods and spaces, so re-importing an old number that differs from the new one only in those ways updates the renamed part.”
  • S7-N7: “S7-N3 to S7-N6 do not apply to the parts CSV import. An import row whose number matches a part already stocked at this location updates that part (S13-N9a). It is never refused for a duplicate number.”
